# ⚠️ Renamed to rhuruphansen/php-github-runner

This image has been renamed to [`rhuruphansen/php-github-runner`](https://hub.docker.com/r/rhuruphansen/php-github-runner). For now, this name still gets the same builds and tags, so existing setups keep working. **It will stop receiving updates and be deleted later**, so switch your `image:` to the new name.

Source and documentation: [github.com/rhurup/php-github-runner](https://github.com/rhurup/php-github-runner)
